content.title: Microsoft Neocloud Deals Cross $60 Billion in AI Spending Frenzy
content.summary: The largest chunk of that spending — about $23 billion — is going to British startup Nscale, according to people familiar with the situation, who requested anonymity to discuss the previously undisclosed sum.  The arrangement with Nscale will give Microsoft access to about 200,000 of Nvidia Corp.’s latest GB300 chips at sites in the UK, Norway, Portugal and Texas.  Like its peers, the world’s largest software company is struggling to get data centers online quickly enough to meet demand from customers and internal teams developing artificial intelligence tools.
